svg.title: Summing root bounds over all sites gives absolute convergence of L at fixed torus, with total at most |Λ|γ/(1 −q). The rooted-tree estimate and its breadth-first interval construction are the remaining combinatorial ingredients behind this bound; the occurrence/root normalization and transfer to the union support have been made explicit here. The real logarithmic identity follows without assuming Z(w) > 0. First restrict to a finite alphabet of s labels. Let P(t) = Z(tw), a polynomial of degree at most s, and write L(t) = P n≥1 lntn for the connected series. The finite graph decomposition into connected components gives the coefficient recurrence
